definitions.explanation: The night before today. Can also be read as ゆうべ.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|さくや}は{よく|よく}{眠|ねむ}れた。
{昨夜|さくや}から{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}っている。
examples.english: It's been raining since last night.

notes:
{昨夜|さくや} means "last night". This word has two readings.

READINGS:
- さくや: formal/written
- ゆうべ: casual/spoken

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昨夜|さくや}の{出来事|できごと} (events of last night)
- {昨夜|さくや}から (since last night)

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {今夜|こんや}: tonight
- {昨日|きのう}: yesterday
- {夕べ|ゆうべ}: last night (alternative writing)
